root_cause_criterion.description: Before `parseSOF()` accepts the lossless-JPEG frame, the parsed component count `sof->cps` must not exceed the already-materialized raw row length `mRaw->dim.x`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches `predictor_copy_sink` with `sof_component_guard.jpeg_component_count=2` and `sof_component_guard.raw_row_length=1`, so the missing predicate is violated while the protected event executes. The fixed original records the same violated predicate but does not execute `predictor_copy_sink`, so it is guarded; the adjacent perturbation `imagewidth2_cps2_boundary` supplies the genuine fixed witness with `2 <= 2` and the protected event executed.

nodes.description: At `copy_n(predNext, N_COMP, pred.data())`, the copy width `N_COMP` is greater than the raw-row component capacity `mRaw->dim.x - offX`, so the read crosses out of the valid row and into ASan-poisoned padding.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `predictor_copy_sink.copy_component_count=2 > predictor_copy_sink.row_component_capacity=1` at the crashing second-row `copy_n()`.

edges.description: The component count admitted at `parseSOF()` is carried through `frame.cps` and selects `decodeN<2>()`, so the same count becomes the `copy_n()` read width at the sink.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `sof_component_guard.jpeg_component_count == predictor_copy_sink.copy_component_count == 2`; the same equality remains true in the genuine witness case `imagewidth2_cps2_boundary`.

edges.description: After the first decoded row sets `predNext = dest`, the same previous-row start pointer is reused unchanged as `predNext` at the second-row predictor reload.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `prednext_alias.row_start_ptr == predictor_copy_sink.prednext_ptr` on the crashing path, proving the second-row sink reloads from the first row start pointer.
